Ramayana: Part 1 film review in Hindi. It is the first of a two-part film. The film stars Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, Sai Pallavi, Sunny Deol, Ravi Dubey, Anupam Kher, Kajal Aggarwal, Rakul Preet Singh, Vivek Oberoi, Kunal Kapoor, Adinath Kothare, Arun Govil, Indira Krishnan, and Lara Dutta. This epic mythological film produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, who co-wrote the screenplay with Shridhar Raghavan. Ramayana Part 1 is running in theatres. Watch the video to know more.
